name: folly-case-files
description: Rivers of London RPG character sheet management
comment:overrides: Security pins for Excalidraw's transitive deps. lodash-es <=4.17.23 (code injection / prototype pollution) -> 4.18.1, the official patch by lodash author jdalton. nanoid: core uses the 3.x line (-> 3.3.8 fix); mermaid-to-excalidraw pins the 4.x line, whose fix is 5.0.9, scoped so it doesn't disturb core. dompurify <=3.4.10 (Trusted Types policy survives clearConfig GHSA-vxr8-fq34-vvx9; permanent ALLOWED_ATTR pollution via setConfig GHSA-cmwh-pvxp-8882) -> 3.4.11, pulled in via mermaid. Re-check with `npm audit` when bumping @excalidraw/excalidraw.
comment:deprecations: Known-error register for transitive deprecation warnings emitted by `npm ci` (not vulnerabilities; npm ci still exits 0). Disposition of each is the maintainer's decision, not recorded here unless they set it. (1) sliced@1.0.1 via png-chunks-encode via @excalidraw/excalidraw -- DEV-ONLY, absent from production when installed with `npm ci --omit=dev` (see scripts/deploy.sh). STATUS: OPEN. (2) prebuild-install@7.1.3 via better-sqlite3 -- PROD, unmaintained but still required upstream (better-sqlite3 12.x also depends on ^7.1.1); no drop-in replacement, so it cannot be cleared without moving off better-sqlite3. STATUS: OPEN, no remediation currently available; awaiting maintainer disposition. Re-evaluate when better-sqlite3 drops prebuild-install, or any native rebuild of better-sqlite3 fails.
